_about: Declaration duties per market. Tree nuts and gluten cereals are listed at the specific level because the markets disagree on members (pine nut is a tree nut for FDA and Health Canada but not under EU Annex II). Sulphites are handled by numeric threshold rules instead of this list, because the thresholds differ (US/Canada: 10 ppm or more; EU: more than 10 mg/kg).

jurisdictions.label: United States
jurisdictions.regulatory_basis: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act as amended by FALCPA (2004) and the FASTER Act (2021); FDA Food Allergen Q&A Guidance, Edition 5 (2025); 21 CFR 101.100(a)(4) for sulfites.

jurisdictions.label: Canada
jurisdictions.regulatory_basis: Food and Drug Regulations (enhanced labelling for food allergens, gluten sources and added sulphites, in force 4 August 2012); Health Canada priority food allergens.

jurisdictions.label: European Union
jurisdictions.regulatory_basis: Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 on the provision of food information to consumers, Annex II (14 substances or products causing allergies or intolerances).
